Container.Name: Marquee-Soundprint
Container.Overview: Music analysis for Marquee: listens to each track on the GPU (or CPU) to power radios, "sounds like", Muse, mixes and mood pages. Install it next to Marquee on the same server; only Marquee talks to it (127.0.0.1:32501). Its models load when needed and unload after a few idle minutes, so the GPU is free otherwise. The first start downloads about 1.5 GB of models into the Models folder.
Container.Requires: Marquee on the same server (host networking). For the GPU install the Nvidia Driver plugin; without an NVIDIA GPU remove --runtime=nvidia from Extra Parameters (analysis then runs on the CPU, more slowly).

Config.Name: Music
Config.Description: The same music folder as in the Marquee container (read-only).

Config.Name: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
Config.Description: Which NVIDIA GPUs it may use.

Config.Name: Unload when idle (minutes)
Config.Description: Models are freed from the GPU after this many idle minutes.
